title: Chapter 452 Unstoppable
content:
Chapter 452 Unstoppable

"This, this,"

Everyone widened their eyes and spoke in silence.

What is even more confused than that is, there is no trace of shadow.

At this moment, his face was pale and his eyes were full of confusion. Just now, another person who made the list appeared. He wanted to throw out a space trap as usual, and then slowly grind the other party to death. Just effortless.

However, the human boy just took a random move and broke his space trap.

With another casual blow, I lost consciousness directly.

Thinking of the aura that he felt from the human boy just now, Ying Wuzhi couldn't help but tremble slightly and blurted out, "Supreme God!"

"What!?"

Everyone suddenly looked up at the Tianjiao List and suddenly found that a name on the Tianjiao List was sprinting towards the ranking above at an extremely fast speed.

Name: Wang Er

Realm: Earth-level Heavenly Supreme

Force: Human Emperor Palace

When I saw the message from that young man, all the creatures present felt extremely unbelievable. The young man from the human race had actually reached the supreme earth-class heaven before long live, such talent and talent.

Everyone took a breath of cold air and admired in their hearts.

"It's worthy of being the bottom of the Human Emperor Palace."

Just like Wang Er's appearance, his name is also very ordinary, but at this moment, no one present dared to underestimate this young man.

Wang Er's realm alone has already surpassed most of the creatures present.

What's more, he's still very young.

Ying Wuzong also restrained his laziness, snorted lightly, and whispered: "Is the Supreme Heaven who is less than ten thousand years old, great?"

This kind of character is a mess in a deserted city.

He is only a thousand years old, and he is almost the kind of person who is always a mess every day. None of the younger generations from the big families next door chase him.

No wonder people in the deserted city cannot participate in the two major lists. If they participate, there will be no matter what the sentient beings in the Chaos Realm are.

However, he was killed once without understanding, and Ying Wuzhi was also aroused by some blood. When he looked up at the genius list, his eyes began to shine with strange brilliance.

The next moment, Shadowless figure disappeared from the spot again.

And at this time, the genius list.

Wang Er, who was unstoppable all the way, frowned slightly, his face with a hint of disappointment.

"I thought this genius list would be of great value. After all, the last one has the highest level of cultivation, but unexpectedly, the more you go, the weaker you will be."

He came here without even looking at the Tianjiao List, and went directly into the list.

How could he know that there would be such a weird thing at the end of the list?

Without spending much time, Wang Er had already reached the top ranking, and some famous geniuses also appeared in front of Wang Er one after another.

But these things cannot arouse Wang Er's interest at all.

To be precise, challenging the Tianjiao List by yourself is just a formality. In the entire Chaos World, no one in the younger generation will be his opponent.

The realm is here.

He is a genius among geniuses, and who can fight him above the level?

Soon, a white figure appeared in front of Wang Er.

Bai Xu.

Seeing the stranger in front of you, Bai Xu raised his eyebrows slightly, "Oh? I didn't expect that there would be a genius who could get here in the human race, but you have already come to an end."

Just seeing Wang Er's image, Bai Xu had already determined that the young man in front of him was not his opponent.

Facing Bai Xu's arrogant attitude, Wang Er's strength denied Bai Xu.

With just one blow, Bai Xu was bombarded to the distance, and his bones were almost disintegrated. If it weren't for the powerful body of his Heavenly Demon Clan, this blow could have ruined him.

Bai Xu is now just in the realm of immortality, and even the opponents of the Supreme Realm cannot resist it. How can he be the opponents of Wang Er in the realm of the Supreme Realm of Heaven?

"Damn it, hell."

Bai Xu collapsed on the ground, no longer able to resist. When he spoke, he kept spitting out meat.

Wang Er did not make any mockery, and another casual blow ended Bai Xu's life.

Immediately afterwards, Wang Er met Xuanwu, one of the four symbols of the Heavenly Demon.

When Xuan Si saw Wang Er, he was a little surprised, "There are actually geniuses in the human race who can defeat Brother Bai."

"In Xia Xuansi, I don't know what friends call me?"

Xuan Si bowed slightly and asked politely.

Wang Er stretched his eyebrows and said softly, "Wang Er."

"Uh, Wang Er, hiss, a good name."

Xuan Si smiled awkwardly and looked at Wang Er seriously again. Is this guy really capable of defeating Bai Xu?

And when the battle began, Xuan Si finally realized that he was looking down at the person.

This kid is actually the Supreme Lord of Heaven.

The turtle was huddled in the terrifying turtle shell, and Xuan Si was shocked.

At this time, his turtle shell kept showing creepy cracks under the terrifying attack of Wang Er. Xuan Si, who knew that he would definitely lose, looked ugly.

His attack ability is not outstanding. The reason why he can get here is Bai Xu depends on his extraordinary defensive measures.

Almost few people can break his defense. Even Bai Xu, who is also the four symbols of the Heavenly Demon, cannot do it.

But when the opponent's realm is crushed, he has no power to fight back. Death is just a matter of time.

After thinking through this, Xuan Si sighed heavily and revealed a flaw.

Although Wang Er was confused, out of rush, he ended Xuan Si's life with one blow.

In this way, Wang Er had already cleaned up two of the four symbols of the Heavenly Demon.

After that, there is an old acquaintance, Gong Ting from the Human Emperor Palace.

"You're indeed here."

When Gong Ting saw Wang Er, his smile was a little bitter.

Wang Er had no expression on his face and said lightly: "Do you still need to fight?"

Gong Ting looked at Wang Er for a moment, and finally shook his head slightly.

The next moment, Wang Er continued to move forward.

Holy Spirit Clan, spirit and so.

"I just knew, how could you have only two young supreme people in your human race?"

When he saw Wang Er, Ling Qi looked solemn.

He did not underestimate the enemy because of Wang Er's ordinary appearance, but instead was more cautious.

As human race, the other side defeated Gong Ting.

But he had never heard of the other party's identity, so there was only one possibility that the other party was secretly cultivated by the human race.

And such an existence is not a general person.

Sure enough, the battle began, and the Supreme Supreme of the King Erdi was inevitably revealed.

Ling Qi's face was shocked. Even though he was already very cautious, he finally lost to Wang Er.

The next one is another acquaintance, Xu Xingcai, the Human Emperor Palace.

"You came later than I thought."

Seeing Wang Er, Xu Xingcai chuckled, smiling a little helpless.

Wang Er nodded slightly, "Because some things have been delayed."

The two said something again, and in the end Xu Xingcai chose to surrender directly.

"It should be the last one."

Wang Er breathed a sigh of relief and took over his last opponent.

Soon, Qinghai's figure appeared in Wang Er's vision.
